title: Structure Of Modern English Ii
modules: Through Structural Grammar In Unit 2, Transformational Generative
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a universal non linguistic concept with three divisions: present, past and future."
Time is a universal non linguistic concept with three divisions: present, past and future.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to signal an abrupt change of ideas."
The dash is used to signal an abrupt change of ideas.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the auxiliary verb that is used to help form the six tenses of the passive voice."
The verb to be is the auxiliary verb that is used to help form the six tenses of the passive voice.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to punctuation marks used within the sentence to point out that the flow of thought in the sentence is interrupted."
Internal punctuation refers to punctuation marks used within the sentence to point out that the flow of thought in the sentence is interrupted.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a noun that names a group or a collection of people or objects usually seen as a unit."
A collective noun is a noun that names a group or a collection of people or objects usually seen as a unit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a childhood disease (verb singular). 46."
Measles is a childhood disease (verb singular). 46.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the present perfect tense, the past perfect tense and the future perfect tense."
The three perfect tenses are the present perfect tense, the past perfect tense and the future perfect tense.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are referred to as subordinating conjunctions."
Indicators of subordination are referred to as subordinating conjunctions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used at the beginning of a sentence unless the sentence follows a semicolon or a colon."
Capital letters are used at the beginning of a sentence unless the sentence follows a semicolon or a colon.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a government of the people, by the people and for the people (three prepositional phrases) 2."
Democracy is a government of the people, by the people and for the people (three prepositional phrases) 2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used singly or doubly to enclose direct quotations."
Quotation marks are used singly or doubly to enclose direct quotations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which cannot occur alone as verb elements in clauses because they cannot take subjects and are invariable in the sense that they do not show tense distinction."
Non-finite verbs are those which cannot occur alone as verb elements in clauses because they cannot take subjects and are invariable in the sense that they do not show tense distinction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good exercise (gerund used as subject) 20."
Swimming is a good exercise (gerund used as subject) 20.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a common structural problem found in the writings of learners of English as a second language."
Subject-verb agreement is a common structural problem found in the writings of learners of English as a second language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rule for forming the negative versions from positive sentences e.g. positive She can draw (Positive) She cannot draw. (Negative) 5."
Tnot is the rule for forming the negative versions from positive sentences e.g. positive She can draw (Positive) She cannot draw. (Negative) 5.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for writing words or word groups of identical grammatical forms when they appear in a series."
Parallel forms are used for writing words or word groups of identical grammatical forms when they appear in a series.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a long distance to walk (Distance = singular). 50."
Twenty kilometres is a long distance to walk (Distance = singular). 50.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the form used to express future time."
The verb shall see is the form used to express future time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in pairs to set off words, phrases, clauses which are explanatory or which are translations or comments."
Parentheses are used in pairs to set off words, phrases, clauses which are explanatory or which are translations or comments.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a grammatical term which is used to tell whether the subject is the one performing or receiving the action of the verb."
Voice is a grammatical term which is used to tell whether the subject is the one performing or receiving the action of the verb.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an interesting pastime. (subject) 10."

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process that involves the change of one linguistic structure to another as for instance, the change of the active to the passive (cf Tomori, 1977, p 66)."
A linguistic transformation is a process that involves the change of one linguistic structure to another as for instance, the change of the active to the passive (cf Tomori, 1977, p 66).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to indicate a stronger break than the comma."
The semicolon is used to indicate a stronger break than the comma.
fib: ______ refer to both sexes; male and female.

subject

Parameters on the other hand

Shall have
Shall have is used in the first person and will have is used in the second and third persons.

______ is used to relate an event or happening expressed by the verb to a time scale in the present or past.
Tense
Tense is used to relate an event or happening expressed by the verb to a time scale in the present or past.
______ is used at the end of an exclamatory sentence, phrase or clause.
exclamation mark
The exclamation mark is used at the end of an exclamatory sentence, phrase or clause.

Conjuncts

indicative mood

Transformational grammar

______ is an interesting subject (singular verb). 45.
Mathematics
Mathematics is an interesting subject (singular verb). 45.
______ is used to make a request or give a command.
imperative mood
The imperative mood is used to make a request or give a command.
______ is used to express a wish or an unreal condition (a condition which is contrary to fact).
subjunctive mood
The subjunctive mood is used to express a wish or an unreal condition (a condition which is contrary to fact).
______ are the infinitive (to dance); the present -ing participle (dancing) and the past -ed participle (danced).
non- finite forms
The non- finite forms are the infinitive (to dance); the present -ing participle (dancing) and the past -ed participle (danced).
______ are the forms that show tense distinction.
Finite forms of verbs
Finite forms of verbs are the forms that show tense distinction.
According to the course material, how many kinds of auxiliary verbs are there? (answer in figures)
three

There are three kinds of auxiliary verbs: (i) Central or Main Auxiliaries: These include do, be and have; (ii) Modal Auxiliaries: These are: can/could, may/might, shall/should, will/would, must and ought to. (iii) Marginal Auxiliaries which are used to, dare and need.
